title: Standing Against Spiritual Attacks Through Faith and Worship
description: Join us for a powerful testimony of faith and resilience as our pastor shares a personal story of spiritual warfare and divine intervention. Learn how he refused to give in to the enemy's attacks, even when his body was weak and his condition was dire, and discover the strategies he used to take authority over the situation and trust in God's sovereignty. This sermon is a must-listen for anyone facing challenges and needing to see the power of faith in action.
